algorithm: Draco 1.5.7 decode; quantized fixed-point node animation, transforms, culling, picking and 600-frame CPU texture rasterization

scenePolicy.nodeTransform: fixed source quaternion [0,1,0,0] followed by the 600-entry integer yaw/bounce table
scenePolicy.skinning: not-applicable: the audited Avocado model declares no skins or joints
scenePolicy.camera: fixed perspective projection into a 96x96 viewport
scenePolicy.picking: 12 fixed frame and screen-coordinate triangle tests with nearest average depth

rendering.controlled: CPU 96x96 rasterization with all 36,864 RGBA bytes retained for each of all 600 frames, plus the complete frame/counter stream
rendering.gpu: separate unavailable product baseline; never enters controlled output
